reports.notes:
MJE had crews of approximately 20 working on rebar, wall forms and foundation slab for Area 5b.
QDC relocated the heaters to the correct location in the Fiber barn, plus installed the heater in the Post Screw building.
Jared pulled new communication wires from the fiber building to Barn 3 electrical room, wiring to second HMI and H2S sensor.
Blue Sky worked on clearing clog from Hospital Pump to Hospital.
4 presses running today.
Electrical wiring completed to our new office location.

MJE crew continues working on rebar and forming walls for digester.
Bennett set filtrate pump for press 6 and began piping.
Jared completed his punch list on electrical work.
Crusting in south lagoon is raising pipes due to high level.

MJE crew continues rebar wall forming on digester. Their crew and Bennett's crew only worked half day due to rain.
QDC completed spray foam insulation on post screw building.
3 presses running, #2 press down.

Plenty of sunshine today. Job site drying out from yesterday's 5/8" of rain. MJE has crews working on digester and Bennett has crew working on piping of press 6.
4 presses running.

MJE crew worked on rebar for slab 5b, ready for concrete 9/9. Rebar for 6b started, to be completed 9/10.
Crew also started the grade for the ﬂare pad and began moving dirt for backfilling.
Bennett used a pump to break up and circulate manure in octagon pit. Bennett crew worked on screw press 6 will finish 9/9.

Lagoons about 3/4 full Bennett helped Matt with hydro-jet, finished screw press 6 and built cross over ladder. Moved and graded dirt around octagon pits.
MJE, UCI and J&R crews worked on rebar and pouring concrete on slab 5b. Finished grade for ﬂare pad 4 presses running.

Iron Horse worked on placing the forms for the ﬂare pad, concrete to be poured thursday. UCI placed rebar for wall 45. MJE placed forms on wall 27, wall 5 formed, pouring tomorrow , wall 7 to be formed tomorrow .
Started to raise the grade for DMT.
Bennett used hydrojet to help Matt with clogged pipe, used hydrojet to dig a trench for the recirculation line.
Removed piping from octagon pump area to raise the manifold. Crew prefabricated piping for the manifold area.

MJE poured wall 5 and placed forms on wall 7. UCI finished forming wall 27. Griffith detailed wall 7 and pre tied walls 22 and 30. Iron Horse poured ﬂare pad. MJE dirt crew worked on building up DMT pad and backfilled east side of DVO.
Bennett continued working on lifting the manifold by removing piping and installing new piping for the permanent recirculation line.

MJE Stripped wall 5 and put forms on wall 7. UCI poured wall 27. Griffith premier wall 22 and 30. MJE dirt crew and 5G placed rocks for perimeter drain. MJE dirt crew finished DMT pad subgrade and continued backfilling DVO. 5G began installing perimeter drain.
Bennett worked on raising the manifold and unclogging the pump recirculating manure. Press 2 was worked on and needed to be rebuilt.
QDC worked on installing pressure sensors for screw press 6 and the conduit for the electrical on press six.
3 presses running most of day until afternoon then 4 ran.

Bennett completed the recirculation line, operational again with permanent piping. Backfilled the trench.
Began raising ﬂush and screen water pit manifold, completed. Flush pit pump is operational as well as recirculation pump.
MJE continued doing rebar and backfilling DVO. Added 6 inches of dirt to the DMT slab area
Bennett is raising the manifold for the supply return and bypass line for the digester. Doing drain piping for DMT. QDC is doing electrical for DMT QDC did electrical the fiber barn on press 6
